title: File:Research Specialist Heather Furey prepares an Argo float (OOI 261).jpg
author: Ocean Observatories Initiative
description: Research Specialist Heather Furey prepares an Argo float for deployment off the stern of the R/V Armstrong. The yellow straps are used to deploy the float while it is still in the box. The cardboard biodegrades in the water and releases the float. Photo by J. Batryn©Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution

title: File:Jess Kozik preparing Core ARGO float (OOI 391).jpg
author: Ocean Observatories Initiative
description: On the way to turn the Irminger Sea Array for the eighth time, the team aboard the R/V Neil Armstrong used transit time to support other ocean observing projects. Shown here is WHOI’s Jess Kozik preparing to deploy a Core Argo float. Argo is an international program that deploys float throughout the global oceans. Credit: ©WHOI John Lund.
